backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date plus prior close history for the accepted compression breakout source and same-day baseline core A/B entry flow from the before-result artifact. Same-ticker core overlap is excluded. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass. A positive replay still requires shared adapter parity before promotion.

hypothesis: Narrow-range compression breakout candidates may be cleaner when same-day core A/B entry flow confirms actionable equity risk and same-ticker core overlap is excluded.
interpretation: The compression core-flow source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or respond by tuning compression, core-flow, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that same-day core flow thins the accepted compression source too far, removes independent winners, or confirms dates where the core stack already captured the cleanest opportunity.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter path and parity tests before forward observation. Live activation would require closed forward replacement rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping same-day core-flow requirements, same-ticker overlap handling, compression lookback, range-expansion ratio, volume, close-location, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT catalyst/flow provenance, closed forward replacement-value rows, or a shared-helper implementation that reproduces a positive lead without production/backtest drift.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Core-flow confirmation was not a sufficient incremental discriminator for narrow-range compression breakouts. It likely removed useful independent candidates or selected risk-on dates where the accepted core stack already owned the highest-quality edge.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code.
